changelog: Fix: the file browser still listed nothing on servers whose backup storage path had been changed after installation (issue #20). St0r read the path from /var/urbackup/backupfolder, which UrBackup only writes at install time — changing the storage path in UrBackup's own UI updates its settings database and leaves that file naming the original directory. Backups kept working while St0r looked in a folder that no longer existed and reported every backup as missing.

St0r now reads the backup storage folder from UrBackup's settings database, which is the authoritative source, and falls back to /var/urbackup/backupfolder (then /etc/urbackup/backupfolder) only when that database cannot be read.

'Backup path not found' now names the path that was actually checked and points at UrBackup's storage setting, so a misconfigured path is obvious from the error instead of looking like a missing backup.
